The failed exact-string check is a confirmed executor false negative for binary inclusion. The searched phrase is inside #ifdef GGML_CUDA_DEBUG in ggml-cuda.cu, while the frozen Release flags define NDEBUG and do not define GGML_CUDA_DEBUG, so its absence from strings output is expected. Stronger read-only ELF evidence shows final definitions of ggml_cuda_op_gated_delta_net and ggml_cuda_op_gated_delta_net_fused_cache, a final local ggml_cuda_try_fuse symbol, and a disassembled call at 0x280eac from ggml_cuda_try_fuse to the fused-cache function through its PLT entry. Thus compilation, direct linkage and a callable internal host route are established; execution of the branch on a model is not established.

Self-linkage and process callability independently reproduce: with LD_LIBRARY_PATH set to the fresh bin directory, ldd resolves all inspected project libraries, including libggml-cuda.so.0, to build-slx03-gdn-audit-03/bin, and llama-server --version exits zero and identifies 87a416bd7. Receipt-time service_before and service_after are byte-identical with PID 121210, zero restarts, active/running and both health checks 200; a read-only audit-time check also found the same state. These facts establish only build callability and service invariance, never model execution, runtime fusion, parity, write reduction, speedup or deployment.

Provenance is not fully signature-grade. provenance.command names the R3 wrapper, but provenance.script incorrectly names and hashes only the imported base runner. PIPELINE froze both files before execution and the wrapper visibly delegates to the base after mutating TASK_ID, BUILD, INPUTS and at_source, which makes the execution reconstructable, but the receipt itself does not bind the commanded wrapper as its script. In addition, PRE_REGISTRATION and the admission list both R1 and R2 watcher FINAL.json files as frozen causal inputs, yet neither file appears in dependency_hashes or provenance.inputs.

RESULT.md emits SLX03_GDN_FUSION_BUILD_NOT_CONFIRMED_R1, which is not in this packet's R3 allowlist. More fundamentally, the immutable receipt still records the preregistered fusion_marker gate as false, and the preregistered abort rule forbids approval when any identity, build, linkage, callability, service or provenance gate fails. Independent forensic evidence can diagnose the harness false negative but cannot retroactively rewrite that frozen gate. Therefore this packet cannot be VERIFIED or PROMOTED, and scientific REJECTION would also overstate a technical negative that the ELF evidence contradicts. It is BLOCKED with no authorized claim code.
